description: Hand-written clean output: every figure from the data, no chatter, constraints met.

sections.summary:
Brightwell Ceramics grew revenue to $58.7M in Q3 2026, up 10.1% on Q2 2026. Two regional distributors renewed on multi-year terms, which supported volume through the quarter.

Gross margin eased to 27.1% from 28.4%. Active customers rose to 2,962 and churn held steady at 4.5%. The NPS survey was postponed, so there is no customer score to report.
sections.analysis:
Revenue increased from $53.3M in Q2 2026 to $58.7M in Q3 2026, growth of 10.1%. Deferred revenue stood at $3.7M, reflecting annual contracts invoiced in advance. Gross margin slipped from 28.4% to 27.1%, and operating expenses changed by 27.3% against the prior quarter.

Customer metrics improved. Active customers grew from 2,794 to 2,962, while churn edged down from 4.6% to 4.5%. Support response times improved after the new triage rota, and the board approved a pricing review for next quarter that could help restore margin.
sections.risks:
- The pricing review could unsettle distributors that have just renewed on multi-year terms.
- Gross margin has slipped to 27.1% and may fall further if the current order mix persists.
- Without an NPS result, early warning of customer dissatisfaction rests on churn alone.
sections.recommendations:
- Share the pricing review timeline with the renewed distributors before any change takes effect.
- Track gross margin by channel each month so the leadership team can see where it is slipping.
- Run the postponed NPS survey early next quarter to restore a direct measure of customer sentiment.
